notes.title: A Bugfix that caused another bug
notes.content:
One player reported that he found a bug when he saves the game and tries to load it again.
After loading the game, the character helmet, glove, boots are gone. I fix the bug, but another bug appears because of that, this new bug breaks the game.

Considering that there only 2 items for each type of these items (2 helmets to be equipped, 2 gloves, 2 boots). I prefer to remove the accessories from the player (helmet, boots, glove). Merchants will not sell these items anymore.

So, it's not possible to equip these items anymore.

Later, to compensate for the removal of these items, I will create new rings and new armors that have stats that will affect the gameplay, because the accessories removed give too small stats to the players.

notes.title: Bug fixes - Cave and character changed
notes.content:
Thank you for all players that pointing out bugs in the game.

The bugs fixed are:

- Bug on cave exit
- Wrong number of enemies to be killed in Ancient Warriors Quest
- When playing the Ranger campaign, if you save the game nearby a certain area, the game changes

I will create a workaround to restore saved games that changed the Ranger character to Knight.

notes.title: New playable character - Ranger is available
notes.content:
The new update is available now.
The Ranger class is available now. 
Control the ranger equipped with her bow and arrows. 
Level up the character to use magic and the new summoning spells.

Warning: It is a good idea to purchase a lot of arrows in the merchant, arrows are not unlimited.
